description: This source file defines the immutable struct 'StreamId' within the Orleans runtime project. The struct uniquely identifies a stream within a provider, providing various factory methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and string formatting. It encapsulates the full key, namespace, and key components of a stream identifier, and includes serialization and formatting capabilities.

classes.name: StreamId
classes.description: A struct representing a unique identifier for a stream in Orleans, combining namespace and key components with serialization and formatting capabilities.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory methods to create StreamId instances from namespace and key parameters, supporting spans, strings, Guids, longs, and stream identities.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this StreamId with another for ordering.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this StreamId and another.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the StreamId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the StreamId.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the StreamId into a span of characters.

methods.name: GetKeyAsString
methods.description: Returns the key component as a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace component as a UTF-8 string.
